title: Elucidating the Space of Enzymatic Reaction: A Unified Benchmark and Pretrained Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.11694v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing reaction models primarily learn molecular transformations, whereas enzy- matic reactions depend jointly on molecular structure and catalytic function. We formulate this problem as learning an enzymatic reaction space linking reactants, products, and Enzyme Commission (EC) annotations. To characterize this space, we introduce VenusRX-Bench, a unified benchmark for forward reaction prediction, single-step retrosynthesis, and EC-number prediction. VenusRX-Bench integrates reactions from multiple biochemical databases with standardized curation, leakage- controlled splits, and consistent evaluation. Benchmarking representative chemical and enzymatic models reveals a clear chemical-to-enzymatic domain gap, driven by limited domain data, catalytic-context dependency, and the difficulty of modeling large biomolecular structures. translated_title: 阐明酶促反应空间：统一基准与预训练模型
translated_abstract: 现有的反应模型主要学习分子转化，而酶促反应则同时依赖于分子结构和催化功能。我们将该问题形式化为学习一个连接反应物、产物与酶学委员会（EC）注释的酶促反应空间。为了刻画这一空间，我们提出了VenusRX-Bench，一个涵盖正向反应预测、单步逆合成和EC编号预测的统一基准。VenusRX-Bench整合了来自多个生化数据库的反应数据，采用标准化的数据整理、防泄漏的数据划分和一致的评估方式。对代表性化学模型和酶学模型的基准测试揭示了一个明显的从化学到酶学领域的差距，其成因包括领域数据有限、对催化上下文的依赖，以及大型生物分子结构建模的困难。为了弥合这一差距，我们开发了VenusRX，一个面向酶促反应的统一T5风格序列到序列模型……
tldr: 该论文提出了统一基准VenusRX-Bench和预训练模型VenusRX，通过学习连接反应物、产物与EC注释的酶促反应空间，弥合了化学反应模型与酶促反应建模之间的领域差距。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces VenusRX-Bench, a unified benchmark, and VenusRX, a T5-style pretrained model, which bridge the chemical-to-enzymatic domain gap by learning an enzymatic reaction space linking reactants, products, and EC annotations.
